typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BossDataSource as string (),
	BossInitialCatalog as string (),
	BossPassword as string (),
	BossUserName as string (),
	Counter as integer (),
	CreateExcelTableSql as string (),
	CriticalEventSeverityID as integer (),
	EventTypeID as integer (),
	ExcelWorksheetName as string (),
	ExtractFileExtension as string (),
	ExtractFileName_MA as string (),
	ExtractFileName_MS as string (),
	ExtractFileName_PDP as string (),
	ExtractFilePath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	FileNamePrefix_MA as string (),
	FileNamePrefix_MS as string (),
	FileNamePrefix_PDP as string (),
	InfoEventSeverityID as integer (),
	MaxCount as integer (),
	MedicareSql as string (),
	MedSuppSql as string (),
	ModuleID as integer (),
	PDPSql as string (),
	ReportingDate as string (),
	Threshold as integer ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		CSCS_ID as string,
		BLDF_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		BLDF_TERM_DT as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE  	@Threshold FLOAT = ?,  	@PageNumber INT = ?,  	@Start INT,  	@End INT   SET @Start = ( 	SELECT (ABS(@PageNumber-1)*@Threshold) + 1 )   SET @End = (  	SELECT @PageNumber*@Threshold )   SELECT  	SBSB_ID,  	GRGR_ID,  	CSCS_ID,  	BLDF_EFF_DT,  	BLDF_TERM_DT  FROM Invoice.Medicare_EFT_Subscribers  WHERE RowNumber BETWEEN @Start AND @End',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> MedicareEFTSubscribersBOSS
MedicareEFTSubscribersBOSS derive({Copy of GRGR_ID} = toString(GRGR_ID),
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} = toString(SBSB_ID),
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} = toString(CSCS_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		BLDF_EFF_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} as string,
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} as string,
		BLDF_TERM_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MedicareEFTSubscribersEXCEL
DataConversion sink(input(
		BLDF_EFF_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} as string,
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} as string,
		BLDF_TERM_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MedSuppEFTSubscribersEXCEL
DataConversion sink(input(
		BLDF_EFF_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		{Copy of CSCS_ID} as string,
		{Copy of GRGR_ID} as string,
		{Copy of SBSB_ID} as string,
		BLDF_TERM_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PDPEFTSubscribersEXCEL
